requirements.evidence: Config key added at config/services.php:40 ('mention_id' => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID')) and .env.example:78-79. Mention is validated by MentionIdPattern '/\A[0-9]{17,20}\z/' (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:31) and appended as "\n<@{$id}>" (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:103). formatContent reserves mb_strlen($mention) characters before truncating the body, so the mention survives and total stays within MaxContentLength (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:74-79); with no mention mb_strlen('')=0 leaves behaviour unchanged. Invalid/unset values return '' (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:93-100), and trim() keeps embedded-newline payloads like "123\n@everyone" rejected by the anchored \A...\z pattern. Docs updated in docs/ops/devops.md:61,72-73 and docs/ops/logging.md:83.

conventions.evidence: Follows most conventions: Pest tests added under tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:125-231, docs kept in sync for .env.example/docs/ops/*, sibling style preserved (typed constant, private helper), no service layer introduced. security.evidence: No new input surface: the id is read from config and strictly validated with '/\A[0-9]{17,20}\z/' (ASCII digits only, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:31), so @everyone/@here, newline payloads and '<@...>' strings cannot produce a mention (tests at tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:198-211). Only digits are interpolated into the mention (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:103); no secrets are logged or exposed and existing redaction/no-op/soft-fail paths are untouched.

tests.evidence: Comprehensive Pest coverage for the new behaviour: mention appended on its own line (tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:130-146), integer and whitespace-trimmed ids (:148-166), null/empty ids emit no '<@' (:168-182), twelve invalid inputs rejected (:184-211), and the 1800-char cap with the mention preserved (:213-231). Existing redaction/no-op/soft-fail tests are unchanged.

simplicity.evidence: Minimal, direct change: one config line (config/services.php:40), a single private helper mention() (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:85-104) and a two-line reserve/append in formatContent (:74-79); reuses the existing MaxContentLength and config() rather than adding abstractions.

readability.evidence: Clear names (MentionIdPattern, mention()), focused helper with a docblock explaining the return value (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:82-84), and an explanatory comment for the reserve logic (:76). Consistent with the surrounding class style; no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, .env.example, the two ops docs and the test file. No unrelated refactors or extra features.

issues.explanation: conventions.md:103 asks for a Keep-a-Changelog entry under [Unreleased] alongside the code change, but the new DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting is not recorded there.

review.summary: The change adds a DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting and appends a validated 17-20 digit Discord snowflake mention on its own line, reserving room within the 1800-character cap, with matching .env/docs updates and thorough Pest tests. The implementation correctly handles empty/invalid ids, integer values and truncation, and respects the security constraints; the only gap is the missing CHANGELOG entry required by the project conventions.
